name: tenants_reorder_pay_bands
description: Change the order of the tenant's pay bands. pay_band_ids lists every band once, from tenants_pay_bands, position 1 first. Of the bands that match a seat, the last has the last word, so moving a band can change what a seat costs: every plan reprices. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin. Pass from_pay_band_ids, the order you read, and the reorder is refused if another change has moved the list since.

from_pay_band_ids.description: the order you read from tenants_pay_bands
